additive.how_the_identity_is_kept_stable: canonical_payload_bytes excludes nulls, which keeps the stored bytes stable and does nothing for canonical_json, which is what the contract hashes. hypothesis_class is named in CANONICAL_ABSENT_WHEN_EMPTY for the second half. The D5 test that measures this is what found the difference

condition_20_row.class_checked_against: the classes the artifact loader implements, so a class nobody can load is refused where the row is built rather than at activation, where the bytes would already be stored
condition_20_row.counts_come_from: DecisionCensusV4, the one place the independence rule is implemented; a builder taking two integers would let a replicated set through wearing a different field name

dispatch.shape: D3/D4 payload with no hypothesis class

not_a_refusal_and_deliberately_so.case: a JSON object carrying no schema_name at all
not_a_refusal_and_deliberately_so.why: the legacy shape predates the field, so an object without one is read as version 1 rather than rejected. That is released behaviour and the reason the D3 loader refuses it a step later, by version, instead of here

refusals.error: condition 20 names hypothesis class 'graph-neural-ranker-v1', which no loader implements; known: ['pairwise-contrastive-linear-v1']
condition 20 names hypothesis class '', which no loader implements; known: ['pairwise-contrastive-linear-v1']

refusals.case: a census on a row nobody measured
refusals.error: a gate nobody ran has no census; record the not_measured row without counts

refusals.case: bytes declaring a schema nobody publishes

refusals.error: promotion payload bytes are not JSON

refusals.case: legacy bytes read through the D3 loader
refusals.error: these are schema version 1 bytes; read them through the legacy assessment contract, not the D3 payload

schema.name: d3-promotion-payload
schema.why_the_version_does_not_move: bumping the name or the version would make every D3 and D4 payload unreadable through load_promotion_payload, which is the opposite of what this item asks for. The field is additive and optional; the dispatch is unchanged

what_this_does_not_claim: no D5 promotion payload exists. S21D5-035 selected no candidate, so there is nothing to promote and S21D5-067, which would build the real payload, stays closed. This is the shape a successor writes into, measured now because it depends on the pre-registration rather than on a result
